patch_description: Instead of stochastic simulated annealing, this approach uses **smooth-surrogate continuation with deterministic compass (pattern) search**. The non-smooth objective min(area) is replaced by a soft-min via LogSumExp with temperature T; we run a temperature homotopy (T: 0.05 → 0.002), optimizing the smooth surrogate at each stage with a deterministic coordinate-wise pattern search (try ±step per coordinate, accept improvements, shrink step on failure). The smooth surrogate gives usable descent directions even when the true minimum is tied among many triangles (a classic trap for greedy annealing), while the temperature schedule gradually sharpens the surrogate toward the true objective. Multiple structured, deterministic initializations (rings, 3-fold symmetric triangle layout, grids) are all refined this way, followed by a strict greedy polish on the exact minimum, and the best configuration is rescaled to unit hull area. This is fully deterministic, gradient-free, and avoids the greedy-climbing trap that limits pure annealing.
